fields.label: Title
fields.description: Matches the mobile post-ad wizard's title field (maxLength 70)

fields.label: Status
fields.description: Active/Paused/Sold are owner-controlled transitions (see souq_masr.api.v1.listings). Rejected is reserved for a future moderation flow — not exercised by the mobile app yet. No real review gate exists today (matches the mobile app's own MyAd status decision, store/useAppStore.ts's addMyAd comment), so new listings default straight to Active.

fields.label: Location
fields.description: Governorate, city, or area node — city/governorate display strings for the mobile app are derived server-side from this via get_location_path, not stored redundantly here.

fields.label: Images
fields.description: Ordered by row position (idx). Each row's file_url must belong to a File uploaded by this listing's owner — enforced in souq_masr.api.v1.listings, not at the DocType level (a plain Table field can't express that constraint).

fields.label: Attributes
fields.description: Instance values for this listing's category.fields (Souq Masr Listing Attribute on the category doctype defines the schema; this table holds this one listing's actual key→value pairs).

fields.label: Business Brand Name
fields.description: Free-text business brand name, distinct from the taxonomy Brand link — mirrors mobile Listing.brandName
